name: OBD: read permanent DTCs (mode 0A)
description: Read-only. Permanent DTCs (cannot be erased by mode 04; they clear themselves after the monitor passes). Not supported by older ECUs. Defaults to OBD ECU #1 (0x7E0/0x7E8, ISO 15765-4); enter another ECU's ids in the Target fields to address it instead.
